1x1.footprintEncoding: Parent [data-plot-index] div gets inline style `gridColumn: col+1 / span w` / `gridRow: row+1 / span h` (TownGrid.tsx). PlaceholderBuilding renders BuildingArt with w/h props forwarded from footprintOf(building) (placement.ts). BuildingArt reads w/h to pick isometric cube geometry + viewBox width (buildingArt.tsx viewWidthFor/buildingCube); no separate data-w/data-h DOM attribute exists, only data-archetype on .building-tile.
